target_customer: Crypto and fintech developers and companies that wanted to measure the carbon footprint of crypto use and financial activity and fund carbon removal
problem: Crypto and financial activity had a carbon footprint that was hard to measure, and buying removal required manual work with offset marketplaces.
business_model: usage-based API (private beta, no pricing found)
product_category: Carbon accounting and carbon removal API

founders.name: Taishi Nojima
prior_employers: Facebook (threat detection, incident response, digital forensics)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he has a SIGCOMM paper on network verification and is now building a stealth startup.

competitors.name: Patch
competitors.what: Carbon offset API that calculated footprints and funded offset projects
competitors.funding_then: 4.5 million dollars round led by Andreessen Horowitz

technical_complexity.rationale: An emissions estimation API plus routing payments to removal projects is standard engineering; the CTO had infrastructure and smart contract experience. The hard part was data credibility, not code.

defensibility.rationale: Carbon API peers such as Patch were already funded and the product was in closed beta with no visible data or network advantage.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent move found; the company simply went inactive on the YC directory.

market_need_then: Crypto energy use drew heavy criticism in 2021 and carbon offset APIs were attracting venture funding (Patch round, February 2021), but the demand from paying crypto customers was unproven.

branding.domain_note: Used canopi.cash per the YC listing; no purchase history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Developer documentation on a Notion page, closed beta, token-gated access

brand_strength.rationale: Searches found no press, community or brand material beyond the YC listing and a Notion API doc page.

outcome_analysis: Canopi was a crypto and climate API in closed beta in July 2021 and is marked Inactive by YC. No post-mortem, shutdown announcement or funding news was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors are left empty. The founder profiles suggest the CTO later moved to a stealth startup.
notes: Website canopi.cash did not resolve in this session, so it is treated as unreachable (possibly dead). Funding searches found no round; YC standard deal not recorded. Cause of inactivity not public.
